note: Kint integrates the Kint PHP dumper. Global dump helpers d() (rich) and s() (plain) work in PHP and Twig; each helper is a kint.helper.<name> config object (prefix kint.helper.) with keys renderer (FQCN of a Kint renderer), cli_detection (bool), mode (default|exit|messenger). Ships kint.helper.d and kint.helper.s. Main settings in kint.settings: early_enable (bool, default false), date_format (string nullable, default '[c]'), rich_theme (string, default 'original.css'), use_kint_trace_in_devel (bool, default true). Settings form at route kint.form (/admin/config/development/kint). Output gated by permission 'access kint dumps' after auth (and early_enable before auth). Medium/hard cases read and write those real config objects (kint.settings and kint.helper.*).

evals.prompt: After enabling the Kint module for Drupal, which dump helper functions does it give you to inspect variables, and can you use them in Twig templates?
evals.expected_output: It provides the global d() (rich renderer) and s() (plain renderer) dump functions, usable in PHP and, via kint-twig, in Twig templates ({{ d(var) }}) when Twig development mode is on.

evals.prompt: Where is the Kint settings page in a Drupal site, and which permission controls whether a user sees Kint dump output after logging in?
evals.expected_output: Settings are at /admin/config/development/kint (route kint.form). After authentication, the 'access kint dumps' permission controls whether dump output is shown.

evals.prompt: Which Kint config setting decides whether dumps are visible before a user authenticates, and which setting chooses the rich renderer's visual theme?
evals.expected_output: early_enable (kint.settings) controls visibility of dumps before authentication; rich_theme (kint.settings) selects the rich renderer theme (e.g. original.css, solarized-dark.css, or a custom CSS path).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Kint's rich renderer theme has been customized. Inspect the live Kint configuration and report which rich renderer theme is currently selected.
evals.expected_output: kint.settings:rich_theme is 'solarized-dark.css' (and early_enable is on). Read with `drush cget kint.settings rich_theme`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a custom Kint dump helper function has been configured in addition to the default d and s. Inspect the live Kint helper configuration and name the extra helper function.
evals.expected_output: Besides kint.helper.d and kint.helper.s there is kint.helper.kdump, i.e. a custom dump function named kdump. List them with `drush config:status` / configFactory listAll('kint.helper.').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Kint to use the 'Aante dark' rich renderer theme (aante-dark.css) and set the dump footer date format to '[Y-m-d]'. Apply the change to the live site.
On this Drupal site, add a new Kint dump helper function named 'kdd' that behaves as a 'dump and die' (mode exit) using the Rich renderer. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A config object kint.helper.kdd exists with mode 'exit' and renderer Kint\Renderer\RichRenderer (creating the global kdd() dump-and-die helper).
